 Print The latest episode of Rise and Fall 2 witnessed several emotional moments as family members of the contestants entered the house. The show confirmed that each contestant would get 10, 12, 16, 20 or 25 minutes to meet their family members, with contestants choosing the time cards in random order. Among the first family members to enter the house were Priyanka Chahar Choudhary ’s brother, Yogesh, Niharika Tiwari’s mother, and Jashwant’s father. Seeing her brother, Yogesh, Priyanka Chahar Choudhary broke down emotionally and told him that she had not been doing well mentally on the show and felt targeted. She shared how the other contestants had repeatedly called her a liar and cornered her. Yogesh comforted her and assured her that she was doing well on the show and did not need to worry. He also advised her not to get into every argument and to choose her battles carefully. The siblings then shared some wholesome moments together. Watch Sneak Peek Into Rise & Fall’s Tower, Meet Virender Sehwag & 15 Contestants The family members were subsequently asked to interact with the other contestants in the house. Yogesh met everyone, including the basement workers and the penthouse rulers. During his conversations, he advised Shehzad Poonawalla against making personal or below-the-belt remarks. He also told Gautam Gulati to take a stand if someone abused a woman in front of him. While Gautam agreed with his point, Shehzad got into a tiff with Yogesh. The next family member to enter the house was Niharika Tiwari’s mother. Niharika became emotional as she finally got to hug her mother and expressed how much she had missed her. The two shared an adorable moment, with Niharika’s mother also advising her not to fight with Shehzad Poonawalla. Next, Jashwant’s father entered the house and spent some time interacting with the contestants. Meanwhile, the new promo of Rise and Fall 2 revealed that Rishabh Jaiswal’s girlfriend is set to enter the house next. She is also expected to get into an argument with Shehzad Poonawalla, hinting at more drama in the upcoming episode. Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more. Download the TOI app.
